question: Does ALFRED's public graph CSV endpoint return a DFII10 observation series bounded by a requested 2022-12-30 vintage without a form POST or account key?
identity_gate: Require HTTP200 and CSV whose header identifies DFII10, contains dated finite observations spanning at least 2018-10-01..2022-12-28 and no observation after vintage 2022-12-30. Compare its last observation date and at least one contemporaneous value to official ALFRED page/previous Treasury current capture. A 200 current-history response ignoring vintage fails this gate. Preserve raw bytes, headers and UTC receipt regardless of outcome.
interpretation_boundary: Even a passed as-of 2022-12-30 graph proves only one historical snapshot. It does not supply initial-release values for each 2018-2022 decision day, intraday publication clocks, 2023-2026 held vintages, a predictive factor or a Stage1 0bp account.
NAS_backup: Publish exact response bytes, headers, request UTC and source manifest to immutable Yanxuan NAS; verify remote hash and scoped cold restore.
stop: On transport, identity or NAS failure, record concrete reason, no retry or alternate query for this fixed version.
